title: Universal Access Initiative Launched to Improve Mobility for People with Disabilities in Hofuf
summary: A new initiative titled 'Universal Access' has been launched in Hofuf, Saudi Arabia, to facilitate transportation and mobility for individuals with disabilities, aiming to enhance accessibility in the local area.
body:
A new initiative titled 'Universal Access' has been launched in Hofuf, Saudi Arabia, to facilitate transportation and mobility for individuals with disabilities, aiming to enhance accessibility in the local area.
